name: ROS CDR Parser
description: Decodes ROS 1 and ROS 2 messages, with definitions in .msg or IDL form, into plottable fields. Common sensor and visualization messages (images, point clouds, occupancy grids, grid maps, TF, markers, and yolo_msgs detections as image annotations) are shown in the 2D image and 3D scene views.
author: PlotJuggler Team
